title: When Unpaired Sets Support Shared-Corruption Calibration: Moment Geometry and Two-Sample Precision
summary: Collections of diverse observations often share one acquisition, processing, geometric, or channel corruption, while only an unpaired clean reference set is available. For a prescribed low-dimensional correction shared across observations, the observed and clean reference sets support inference only through the response of fixed moments. We formulate this problem as two-sample moment calibration and report a rank-aware information state combining local rank, scaled moment sensitivity, source-separated covariance, and a moment compatibility residual.
